name: LegalZoom Compliance
description: Form US LLCs, Delaware C-Corps, obtain EIN tax numbers, and maintain registered agent compliance.
fullDescription: LegalZoom is a leading provider of online legal solutions for small business owners and cross-border founders. It helps overseas entrepreneurs establish US business entities (Delaware, Wyoming, Florida LLCs), acquire federal Employer Identification Numbers (EINs), and maintain registered agent legal compliance.
features: Comprehensive US LLC and corporate formation in all 50 states
Federal Tax ID (EIN) acquisition service for non-US resident founders
Dedicated Registered Agent service to handle state and court correspondence
Custom operating agreements, corporate bylaws, and business contracts
Ongoing annual report compliance and business license advisory services
